entities.summary: Thomas Fredrik Georg Funck was a Swedish baron (freiherr), author of children's literature, a radio personality and a voice artist, most famous for his stories about Charlie Strap and Froggy Ball. He is the brother of Hasse Funck. He was married to Eva Funck and they have a son Gustav.
